subject: Analog Electronics
questionText:
In the following op-amp circuit, given that open loop 
voltage gain Aol = 10 k. If output resistance of op-
amp is zero then closed-loop input impedance at the 
non-inverting terminal of the op-amp is 
 
 
(a) 10 k 
(b) 25 k 
 
(c) 0.1 M 
(d) 500 M
explanation: Practice Question from Analog Electronics DPP-05 (EC/EE/IN).
